# Science and Math with Mrs. Lau

> > Educational blog by Bethany Lau featuring science and math teaching strategies, classroom management tips, and curriculum resources for elementary through high school educators.

Mrs. Lau shares practical teaching advice, creative lesson ideas, and collaborations with educators like Becca the Science Girl and Rachel Lynette. The site focuses on making science and math accessible through innovative pedagogical approaches including literacy integration, scaffolding techniques, and engaging assessment methods.
